description: Use this when the user has confirmed a plan_dependency plan that changes which components of a dependency the site already watches, or how serious each is. Returns the dependency as it now watches. Spends no monitors. Safe to repeat: the same plan id returns the first result. Not for adding a dependency the site does not watch yet: add_dependency adds one.

confirm.description: The plan's confirm sentence, exactly as returned; show it to the user first.

name: apply_dependency_change
title: Change a dependency's components
